# wso2is_workflow_association (Resource)

Makes a user or role operation wait for approval through a `wso2is_workflow`. To import, use the association ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_role" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
}

resource "wso2is_workflow" "approvals" {
  name  = "Administrator approval"
  steps = [{ role_ids = [data.wso2is_role.admin.id] }]
}

resource "wso2is_workflow_association" "deletions" {
  name        = "User deletions need approval"
  operation   = "DELETE_USER"
  workflow_id = wso2is_workflow.approvals.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Association name.
- `operation` (String) Operation: `ADD_USER`, `SELF_REGISTER_USER`, `DELETE_USER`, `UPDATE_ROLES_OF_USERS`, `ADD_ROLE`, `DELETE_ROLE`, `UPDATE_ROLE_NAME`, `UPDATE_USERS_OF_ROLES`, `DELETE_USER_CLAIMS` or `UPDATE_USER_CLAIMS`.
- `workflow_id` (String) Workflow ID.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the association is active. The default is `true`.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules that decide when an operation needs approval. Approval is needed when any rule matches. A rule matches when all of its expressions match. Without rules, every operation needs approval. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Association ID.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `expressions` (Attributes List) Expressions, all of which must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--expressions))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--expressions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.expressions`

Required:

- `field` (String) Field, for example `role` or `user.groups`.
- `operator` (String) `equals` or `notEquals`.
- `value` (String) Value to compare with.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_workflow_association.deletions <association_id>
```
